Description: IVX Health operates outpatient infusion centers that service patients within communities. IVX Health serves as what is called a site of care, and as end-to-end medical practice that would normally include diagnostic, treatment, and management medical infrastructure, their clinics are built and housed with only the medical licenses and medical treatment hardware required for them to fulfill their clinical duties. They employ nurses and nurse practitioners whose primary role is the administration of biologic drugs, as ordered by patient's referring and managing physician, through either IV infusion or subcutaneous injection. Treatment times vary between about 30 minutes and four hours depending on the therapy and prescribed treatment regimen. during this time, their patients typically engage with staff or enjoy the entertainment within their private suites. Medical call buttons are within each treatment room and ADA-compliant restroom to ensure patients can retrieve staff members in the event of any need. Additional Staff Comment: Medical Practitioner Office
